steps.name: distil
steps.note: The fermented milk is heated in a pot under a cooled lid or vessel, and the vapour that condenses is caught as the spirit, at about 10-20 % alcohol.

links.name: Eternal Landscapes: Mongolia's traditional dairy products

sources.text: That arkhi is the distilled fermented milk (airag is one base), and the heating over a pot with condensation dripping into a bowl, giving 10-20 % alcohol, from the travel site (low authority); Wikipedia says up to 10 % depending on the distillation cycle.
